lead: A dialog that asks for an explicit answer (deleting, irreversible actions): clicking the backdrop or pressing Esc doesn't close it, and it has no close button in the corner by default. It reuses Dialog's theme styles.

api.title: API Reference
api.description: `AlertDialog.Title` / `Description` / `Body` / `Footer` are the same as Dialog's parts of the same name.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: AlertDialog has no CSS file of its own: all its styles come from `dialog.css`. As with every overlay, `data-skein-theme` must be on `<html>`.
styling.slots: The same slots as Dialog, so theme styles need nothing extra
styling.alert: Written on the dialog; theme styles can use it to style confirmation dialogs differently
